offline_event_path_check.limits: Covers the supplicant and the kernel cfg80211/mac80211 paths. The ARM build and the vendor MT7601 driver run only on hardware.

root_cause.confidence: confirmed offline by reproduction and fix on mac80211_hwsim; consistent with the host access point log
root_cause.mechanism: wpa_supplicant 2.11 reports a completed connection with a single wpa_msg call in wpa_supplicant/wpa_supplicant.c, guarded by #if defined(CONFIG_CTRL_IFACE) || !defined(CONFIG_NO_STDOUT_DEBUG). The trial runtime has no control interface and sets CONFIG_NO_STDOUT_DEBUG, so that call was compiled out. The other four fixed events kept their call sites.
root_cause.why_offline_checks_missed_it: The builder only required each fixed event name to survive in the executable, and the event-only patch keeps the names in its own table. qemu-user cannot associate, so no offline ARM test could reach a connection.

scope: Fourth physical trial (one-shot OpenIPC kernel with stock userland and the auth-config fix), then offline analysis and fix of its missing connection event. The analysis and fix used no camera access, flash write or reboot.
